titulo: Matt Groening lets slip that Simpsons: Hit & Run might be making a comeback
cuerpo: At D23, when asked about the potential for a sequel to the cult classic The Simpsons: Hit & Run game, Matt Groening replied, "I think the original game is coming back in some form," before current showrunner Matt Selman added, "or not."
